Swing carefully

Day 9’s prompt was “swing.” Rather than get creative with the interpretation of the word, I decided to stick to a traditional swing idea, but combine it with a ridiculous place to swing. The ISS is just too ridiculous, don’t swing up there.

About this piece

Day 9’s prompt was “swing.” Rather than get creative with the interpretation of the word, I decided to stick to a traditional swing idea, but combine it with a ridiculous place to swing. The ISS is just too ridiculous, don’t swing up there.

Images used

The Kounotori H-II Transfer Vehicle 8 (HTV-8) from the JAXA

The Kounotori H-II Transfer Vehicle 8 (HTV-8) from the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency is pictured attached to the International Space Station's Harmony module.

I took this shot in a middle of "the vallée des merveilles" in the south Alps. I couldn't see anything neither hear a single sound, everything was so quiet and so dark. But gradually I started to hear a breath, a whisper. And I think for the first time in my life I heard the stars sing..
